title: Shanghai Yangshan Berth Stoppage
source: East Asia Maritime Bureau Telemetry + AISStream
summary: Crane automation desynchronization & tidal queue lock. Inbound vessel Ever Vanguard held in outer anchorage fairway 3.
corridorImpact: Direct delay to Detroit plant tier-1 semiconductor deliveries.

title: Bab el-Mandeb / Southern Red Sea Threat Corridor
locationName: Bab el-Mandeb Strait / Gulf of Aden
summary: Unmanned aerial drone attacks and naval warnings forcing container carriers to divert around Africa via Cape of Good Hope (+14 days transit).
corridorImpact: Fuel surcharges up 45%; transit times expanded from 22 to 36 days.

title: Strait of Hormuz Tanker Escort Alert
source: gCaptain Global Wire + Lloyd's List Intelligence
summary: Naval patrol GPS spoofing and maritime inspection halts. VLCC tankers advised to maintain radar silence through international shipping separation scheme.
corridorImpact: Petrochemical feedstock supply delays affecting synthetic rubber & plastic resin tiers.

title: Port of Busan Container Dwell Surge
summary: Secondary feeder transshipment backlog: Yard utilization reached 89%, average dwell time spiked from 4.1d to 6.2d.
corridorImpact: Feeder connections to North American west coast face 3-day turnaround delays.

title: Panama Canal Gatun Lake Draft Restrictions
summary: Extended seasonal drought reduced maximum allowable transit draft to 44 feet, forcing Neo-Panamax boxships to offload up to 2,000 TEU before transit.
affectedLanes: Asia to US East Coast / Gulf Corridor
corridorImpact: Cargo rerouted overland via California rail ramps or Suez route.

title: Super Typhoon Kagami Open-Ocean Warning
summary: Category 5 storm generating 48ft waves and 135kt sustained winds directly over the primary Great Circle shipping lane. 14 container vessels altering course southward.
corridorImpact: Estimated 5-day arrival slip for Detroit automotive electronics shipments.

title: USMCA Laredo Customs Clearance Throttle
summary: Enhanced compliance inspection on automotive steel & aluminum origin certifications causing 14-mile truck queues at World Trade Bridge.
corridorImpact: Cross-border component flow to Midwest plants delayed by 36-48 hours.

title: Strait of Malacca Congestion Throttle
summary: High-density anchorage queuing outside Port of Singapore; average entry pilot delay is 14 hours.
corridorImpact: Minor delay to tier-2 assembly components inbound from Southeast Asia.
